basic_profile.bio: A recent newcomer to Reddit, just getting the hang of things. I'm a graduate student at Clemson University, pursuing a degree in Environmental Science. Originally from a small town in Ontario, Canada, I'm passionate about sustainable living and have a soft spot for local food scenes. I enjoy gaming, especially Minecraft, and recently started exploring the F3Nation community for fitness motivation. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after classes or during weekends. Currently single, I like spending my free time trying out new recipes, hiking, or improving my Minecraft server.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise mainly revolves around environmental sciences, as I'm deeply involved in research and study through my graduate program. I've picked up a fair amount of knowledge on sustainable practices and local ecosystems. My gaming skills, especially in Minecraft, are self-taught and honed through countless hours of play with friends.
